projects.title: Complete Commercial Buildout - Robinson Township
projects.description: Complete commercial space buildout from shell condition to move-in ready. Project included foundation work, structural improvements, interior buildout with office spaces, restrooms, and all necessary mechanical systems.
projects.challenge: Converting raw commercial space into functional business environment while meeting all commercial building codes and ADA requirements. Required coordination of multiple trades and systems.
projects.solution: Phased construction approach starting with structural and foundation work, followed by mechanical rough-in, then interior buildout and finishing. Ensured all work met commercial standards and regulations.

testimonial.quote: Kletz Contracting transformed our raw commercial space into exactly what our business needed. Professional work that met all commercial standards.
testimonial.author: Owner

projects.title: Complete Office Buildout - PA Land & Title
projects.description: Complete commercial office buildout for PA Land & Title including kitchen installation, ceiling work, flooring, lighting, and full interior finishing. Transformed raw commercial space into a professional office environment.
projects.challenge: Converting an unfinished commercial space into a functional title company office while maintaining business operations timeline and meeting all commercial building codes.
projects.solution: Executed phased construction approach with careful coordination of trades including electrical, HVAC, flooring, cabinetry, and finishing work to deliver a modern, professional office space on schedule.
features: Complete kitchen buildout with custom cabinetry
Drop ceiling installation with recessed lighting
Modern lighting fixtures and electrical work

projects.title: Complete Home Addition with Deck - Meade Drive
projects.description: Complete home addition featuring new living space, covered deck with custom ceiling, foundation work, and comprehensive exterior finishing. Project included structural framing, siding installation, and drainage solutions.
projects.challenge: Adding substantial living space to existing home while ensuring proper structural integration, drainage management, and maintaining architectural consistency with the original brick structure.
projects.solution: Executed multi-phase construction including foundation preparation, structural framing, weatherproofing, and finish work. Implemented proper drainage systems and coordinated utilities to seamlessly integrate new space with existing home.
features: Beadboard ceiling installation on covered deck

projects.title: Whole-House Renovation - Moon Township
projects.description: Top-to-bottom renovation of a two-story Moon Township home, taking it from dated and worn to fully move-in ready. Work spanned the entire property inside and out, including new exterior siding, fresh concrete, a new deck, and a complete interior remodel with a new kitchen, updated bathrooms, flooring, paint, and lighting throughout.
projects.challenge: Modernizing an aging home on a sloped hillside lot meant coordinating exterior, structural, and full interior work on a tight timeline while bringing every finish up to today's standards and ensuring proper drainage and access around the property.
projects.solution: Kletz Contracting managed the project as a single coordinated renovation, sequencing exterior siding and concrete work alongside a full interior gut and rebuild. The result is a clean, contemporary home with durable, low-maintenance finishes and a fresh, consistent look from curb to backyard.
features: New vinyl siding and exterior finishing
Complete kitchen remodel with new cabinetry and appliances
